items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: I think (Mavis Irvin) Levy owned this place, you know, it was part of Birdland.

ctx.x: She had to do something to keep her figure.

Right. A little later on I went into another club on 52nd Street. I think (Mavis Irvin) Levy owned this place, you know, it was part of Birdland. What had really happened, Birdland brought all the bop modern musicians out - Charlie Parker and all of them. Max Roach, Bud Powell, and some
